content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge sets UNDERDETERMINED for Matthew 1:20 because each side supplied a different reading of that single verse, which is the situation K-S2 says cannot support UNDERDETERMINED.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that admits both readings is such a verse.", "room": "\"A verse that admits both readings is such a verse\": I weighed (1) Matthew 1:20 admitting both covenant-presence and physical-source readings, which K-S2 forbids as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, versus (2) whether the judge was instead relying on the whole chain, but the judge text names only the verse and the two answers.", "why": "The text gives no ground other than the two readings of Matthew 1:20, and a verse that admits both readings is exactly what K-S2 bars from grounding UNDERDETERMINED."}
